repos.name: reporium-security
repos.description: Automated security scanning for the Reporium suite — grades every public repo A through F nightly
repos.readmeSummary: Reporium Security is an automated security scanning tool that evaluates public repositories within the Reporium suite on a nightly basis. The system assigns security grades from A through F to help developers identify and address potential vulnerabilities in their codebases. It provides continuous monitoring and assessment of repository security posture across the entire platform.
